items.title: From neural development to regenerative medicine: A research journey in stem cell biology, spinal cord repair, and iPSC-based drug discovery.
items.summary: This commemorative article reflects on a research journey spanning neural development, stem cell biology, regenerative medicine, and iPSC-based drug discovery. My early work focused on RNA-mediated regulation in the nervous system, including studies on myelin basic protein gene regulation and the identification and functional characterization of the RNA-binding protein Musashi. These studies contributed to the conceptual foundation of neural stem cell biology and helped establish methods for identifying and isolating neural stem/progenitor cells, including those present in the adult human brain. Building on this foundation, my colleagues and I pursued translational research in spinal cord injury, ranging from analyses of injury pathophysiology and molecular interventions to preclinical studies using rodent and non-human primate models. These efforts ultimately led to the first-in-human clinical study of induced pluripotent stem cell-derived neural stem/progenitor cell transplantation for subacute spinal cord injury. In parallel, we developed patient-derived iPSC platforms for neurological disease modeling and drug discovery, particularly for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, where iPSC-based screening identified Ropinirole as a therapeutic candidate and enabled reverse translational research linking cellular phenotypes with clinical responses. Looking ahead, I argue that the future of regenerative therapy will depend on the continued integration of developmental biology, stem cell science, disease modeling, rehabilitation, and clinical translation to address unmet medical needs in disorders of the central nervous system.
items.titleZh: 从神经发育到再生医学：干细胞生物学、脊髓修复和基于iPSC的药物发现研究之旅
items.summaryZh: 本文是作者研究生涯的回顾性综述，总结了从神经发育基础研究到再生医学转化的历程。关键内容包括：发现RNA结合蛋白Musashi在神经干细胞中的功能；建立神经干/祖细胞分离方法；开展脊髓损伤的临床前研究并推进至iPSC衍生细胞移植的首次人体试验；利用患者iPSC平台筛选出ALS治疗候选药物罗匹尼罗。文章强调未来再生医学需要多学科整合。
items.insight: 该文章由ALS iPSC药物发现领域的核心研究者撰写，系统梳理了从基础神经发育到临床转化的完整路径，特别是罗匹尼罗的发现过程，为ALS研究者提供了宝贵的转化研究思路和平台建设经验。

aiRead.keyFinding: 作者回顾了其研究历程，包括Musashi在神经干细胞中的作用、脊髓损伤的临床前研究、iPSC衍生细胞移植的首次人体试验，以及利用iPSC筛选出ALS治疗候选药物罗匹尼罗。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述性文章，缺乏原始实验数据，且为作者个人视角，可能存在选择性偏倚。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注罗匹尼罗治疗ALS的后续临床试验结果，以及iPSC衍生细胞移植在脊髓损伤中的长期安全性和有效性数据。

items.abstractZh: 这篇纪念性文章回顾了涵盖神经发育、干细胞生物学、再生医学和基于iPSC的药物发现的研究历程。早期工作聚焦于神经系统中RNA介导的调控，包括髓鞘碱性蛋白基因调控的研究，以及RNA结合蛋白Musashi的鉴定和功能表征。这些研究为神经干细胞生物学的概念基础做出了贡献，并帮助建立了识别和分离神经干/祖细胞（包括成人脑中的神经干/祖细胞）的方法。在此基础上，作者及其同事开展了脊髓损伤的转化研究，从损伤病理生理学分析和分子干预，到使用啮齿动物和非人灵长类模型的临床前研究。这些努力最终导致了诱导多能干细胞来源的神经干/祖细胞移植治疗亚急性脊髓损伤的首次人体临床研究。与此同时，他们开发了患者来源的iPSC平台，用于神经系统疾病建模和药物发现，特别是在肌萎缩侧索硬化症中，基于iPSC的筛选确定了罗匹尼罗作为治疗候选药物，并实现了将细胞表型与临床反应联系起来的反向转化研究。展望未来，作者认为再生治疗的未来将依赖于发育生物学、干细胞科学、疾病建模、康复和临床转化的持续整合，以解决中枢神经系统疾病中未满足的医疗需求。
items.frontierRationale: 该文章发表于2026年，总结了iPSC技术在ALS药物发现中的最新应用，并强调了从基础发育生物学到临床转化的整合，具有高度的ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Sex-associated differences in routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a retrospective cross-sectional study.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder with substantial clinical heterogeneity. Systemic inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements have both been studied in ALS, but their sex-associated differences within ALS cohorts remain incompletely characterized. To examine sex-associated differences in routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements in patients with ALS, and to determine whether these differences persisted after adjustment for available clinical and anthropometric variables. In this retrospective cross-sectional study, 135 patients with ALS were included. Routine inflammatory markers, including neutrophils, monocytes, lymphocytes, platelets, and erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), were analyzed alongside quantitative neuromuscular ultrasound measurements. Between-sex comparisons were performed, and false discovery rate correction was applied to account for multiple testing. Multivariable linear regression analyses were performed with adjustment for age, disease duration, body mass index (BMI), ALSFRS-R total score, FVC% predicted, smoking status, hypertension, and diabetes. Female patients showed lower ALSFRS-R total scores and higher estimated progression rates in unadjusted comparisons, whereas pulmonary function variables did not differ significantly between sexes. After FDR correction, estimated progression rate, neutrophil count, monocyte count, ESR, and masseter muscle thickness remained significantly different between sexes, while the ALSFRS-R difference was borderline significant. In fully adjusted models, female sex was associated with lower neutrophil count, monocyte count, and median nerve cross-sectional area; biceps brachii thickness showed a less stable association after sensitivity analysis. An exploratory secondary analysis showed lower rectus femoris cross-sectional area during thigh-lift in female patients after full adjustment. In the spline sensitivity analysis, this association remained statistically significant but was interpreted cautiously because it was not present in the earlier adjustment models. Selected routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements differed between male and female patients within this ALS cohort. These findings support consideration of sex and anthropometric context, including body size, when interpreting inflammatory markers and ultrasound-based structural measurements. In the absence of healthy controls, the observed ultrasound differences cannot be attributed specifically to ALS-related biology. Studies with healthy controls, longitudinal functional outcomes, body-composition assessment, and independent multicenter cohorts are needed to clarify the disease-specific and prognostic relevance of these observations.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中常规炎症标志物与神经肌肉超声测量的性别相关差异：一项回顾性横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性研究分析了135例ALS患者的常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声数据，发现女性患者的中性粒细胞、单核细胞计数和ESR较低，咬肌厚度和正中神经横截面积也存在性别差异。这些差异在调整年龄、BMI等变量后部分仍存在，提示解读ALS患者的炎症和超声指标时应考虑性别和体型因素。研究未纳入健康对照，因此无法确定这些差异是否由ALS本身引起。
items.insight: 该研究提示性别是影响ALS患者炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量的重要变量，未来ALS临床试验的生物标志物分层和疗效评估可能需要将性别作为协变量，以避免性别混杂导致的偏倚。

aiRead.keyFinding: 女性ALS患者的中性粒细胞、单核细胞计数和ESR较低，咬肌厚度和正中神经横截面积存在性别差异，且部分差异在调整临床变量后仍显著。
aiRead.limitation: 缺乏健康对照组，无法区分ALS特异性变化；单中心回顾性设计，样本量有限；超声测量的操作者间变异未报告。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注包含健康对照和纵向随访的独立多中心研究，以验证性别差异的疾病特异性和预后价值。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种具有显著临床异质性的进行性神经退行性疾病。系统性炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量均已在ALS中研究，但ALS队列中这些指标的性别相关差异尚未完全阐明。本研究旨在检查ALS患者常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量的性别差异，并确定这些差异在调整可用的临床和人体测量变量后是否持续存在。这项回顾性横断面研究纳入135例ALS患者。分析常规炎症标志物（包括中性粒细胞、单核细胞、淋巴细胞、血小板和红细胞沉降率（ESR））以及定量神经肌肉超声测量。进行性别间比较，并应用错误发现率（FDR）校正以处理多重检验。多变量线性回归分析调整了年龄、病程、体重指数（BMI）、ALSFRS-R总分、FVC%预计值、吸烟状况、高血压和糖尿病。未调整比较中，女性患者的ALSFRS-R总分较低，估计进展率较高，而肺功能变量在性别间无显著差异。FDR校正后，估计进展率、中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数、ESR和咬肌厚度在性别间仍显著不同，而ALSFRS-R差异为临界显著。在完全调整模型中，女性性别与较低的中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数和正中神经横截面积相关；肱二头肌厚度在敏感性分析中关联不稳定。探索性二次分析显示，完全调整后女性患者大腿抬高时股直肌横截面积较低。在样条敏感性分析中，该关联仍具有统计学显著性，但因未在早期调整模型中出现而谨慎解读。该ALS队列中，部分常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量在男性和女性患者间存在差异。这些发现支持在解读炎症标志物和超声结构测量时考虑性别和人体测量背景（包括体型）。由于缺乏健康对照，观察到的超声差异不能特异性地归因于ALS相关生物学。需要包含健康对照、纵向功能结局、身体成分评估和独立多中心队列的研究，以阐明这些观察的疾病特异性和预后相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年发表的ALS队列数据，首次系统评估了常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声的性别差异，具有直接的ALS临床转化价值。

items.title: Pathology of general proprioception in a canine disease model of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Some forms of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) are associated with sequence variants in the superoxide dismutase 1 gene (SOD1). The mechanisms by which these variants contribute to ALS disease pathogenesis are poorly understood. Degenerative myelopathy (DM), a naturally occurring canine disease, shares similarities with some forms of SOD1-associated ALS, especially cases with sensory impairment. While motor pathway involvement in ALS has been extensively studied, sensory pathology has received comparatively less attention. To investigate whether pathology in the general proprioceptive pathway is associated with pelvic limb general proprioceptive ataxia, an early DM sign, we examined sensory system components of this pathway from Pembroke Welsh Corgis with early- and late-stage DM and age-matched controls. The disease was characterized by axonal pathology in the spinocerebellar tracts and the fasciculus gracilis, pronounced accumulation of SOD1-positive inclusions in nucleus thoracicus and dorsal root ganglia (DRG) neurons, and altered SOD1 immunolabeling in dorsal and ventral root axons and ensheathing myelin. Axonal pathology was also observed in a pelvic limb sensory nerve. These findings suggest that pathology in the proprioceptive sensory pathways may play a significant role in general proprioceptive ataxia in DM. Some dogs that were homozygous for the SOD1 risk allele did not develop clinical disease or the associated neuropathology, indicating that other factors in addition to the SOD1 mutation influence disease onset and progression.
items.titleZh: 犬肌萎缩侧索硬化疾病模型中一般本体感觉的病理学
items.summaryZh: 这项研究利用犬类退行性脊髓病（DM）作为ALS模型，发现本体感觉通路（包括脊髓小脑束、薄束、胸核和背根神经节）存在显著病理改变，如轴突变性和SOD1阳性包涵体积累。这些变化与后肢共济失调相关，提示感觉通路在ALS中可能被低估。此外，部分SOD1风险纯合子犬未发病，说明其他因素影响疾病表达。
items.insight: 该研究填补了ALS感觉病理研究的空白，提示本体感觉通路异常可能是ALS早期症状（如共济失调）的基础，为理解SOD1相关ALS的发病机制提供了新视角，并可能推动针对感觉通路的生物标志物开发。

aiRead.keyFinding: 本体感觉通路（脊髓小脑束、薄束、胸核、DRG）存在显著轴突病理和SOD1包涵体积累，与后肢共济失调相关；部分SOD1纯合子犬未发病，提示其他因素参与。
aiRead.limitation: 研究基于犬类模型，结果需在人类ALS中验证；样本量可能有限；未明确其他影响因素的具体性质。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续研究是否在人类ALS患者中验证本体感觉通路病理，以及探索除SOD1外的修饰因素（如遗传或环境）如何影响疾病发生。

items.abstractZh: 某些形式的肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）与超氧化物歧化酶1基因（SOD1）的序列变异相关。这些变异导致ALS疾病发病机制的机制尚不清楚。退行性脊髓病（DM）是一种自然发生的犬类疾病，与某些形式的SOD1相关ALS（尤其是伴有感觉障碍的病例）具有相似性。虽然ALS中运动通路的受累已被广泛研究，但感觉病理学受到的关注相对较少。为了研究一般本体感觉通路中的病理是否与后肢一般本体感觉性共济失调（DM的早期体征）相关，我们检查了来自彭布罗克威尔士柯基犬（早期和晚期DM）及年龄匹配对照组的该通路的感觉系统组成部分。该疾病的特征包括脊髓小脑束和薄束中的轴突病理、胸核和背根神经节（DRG）神经元中SOD1阳性包涵体的显著积累，以及背根和腹根轴突及其髓鞘中SOD1免疫标记的改变。在后肢感觉神经中也观察到轴突病理。这些发现表明，本体感觉通路中的病理可能在DM的一般本体感觉性共济失调中发挥重要作用。一些SOD1风险等位基因纯合子的犬并未发展出临床疾病或相关的神经病理学，表明除SOD1突变外，其他因素也影响疾病的发病和进展。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，聚焦于ALS中常被忽视的感觉通路，利用自然发生的犬类模型，具有直接的ALS相关性，并揭示了SOD1突变之外的因素对疾病的影响。

items.title: When algorithms speak first: The public health risk of consumer AI in ALS diagnosis.
items.summary: Consumer AI platforms are increasingly used by patients to interpret medical reports, including ENMG results for ALS. While AI shows promise in controlled clinical settings (e.g., stroke imaging, melanoma detection), consumer-facing tools often provide overconfident, context-free diagnostic assertions (e.g., 'definitive evidence of ALS'), leading to premature and potentially harmful life-altering decisions. To highlight the clinical, ethical, and regulatory risks of unregulated AI in ALS diagnosis and propose actionable solutions. We present a case of AI-mediated misdiagnosis, analyze the limitations of consumer-facing AI (lack of clinical context, longitudinal data, and specialist oversight), and discuss the "authority paradox" (patients trusting AI outputs over clinicians' nuanced assessments). We propose a structured 4-step clinical approach for managing AI-mediated self-diagnoses and urge regulators to classify such tools as high-risk under the EU AI Act. The uncritical adoption of consumer AI in ALS diagnosis represents a public health risk. Clinicians, regulators, and developers must collaborate to ensure AI serves patients safely and ethically.
items.titleZh: 当算法先开口：消费级人工智能在ALS诊断中的公共卫生风险
items.summaryZh: 这篇观点文章警告，患者使用消费级AI工具解读肌电图等检查结果，可能因AI给出过度自信且缺乏临床背景的结论（如“明确ALS证据”）而导致误诊和不当决策。作者通过一例误诊案例，指出这类AI缺乏专科医生监督和纵向数据，并提出了临床应对的四步流程，同时呼吁监管机构将其列为高风险设备。
items.insight: 这项研究提醒ALS研究者，AI辅助诊断的转化应用必须警惕消费级工具的滥用，其“权威悖论”现象可能影响患者对临床判断的信任，进而干扰早期诊断和临床试验入组，值得在真实世界研究中关注。

items.abstractZh: 消费级人工智能平台越来越多地被患者用于解读医学报告，包括肌电图（ENMG）结果以辅助ALS诊断。尽管人工智能在受控临床环境中显示出潜力（如卒中影像、黑色素瘤检测），面向消费者的工具往往提供过度自信、缺乏背景的诊断断言（例如“ALS的明确证据”），导致过早且可能有害的生活决策。本文旨在强调无监管人工智能在ALS诊断中的临床、伦理和监管风险，并提出可行的解决方案。我们报告了一例人工智能介导的误诊案例，分析了消费级人工智能的局限性（缺乏临床背景、纵向数据和专科医生监督），并讨论了“权威悖论”（患者信任人工智能输出而非临床医生的细致评估）。我们提出了一种结构化的四步临床方法来管理人工智能介导的自我诊断，并敦促监管机构根据欧盟人工智能法案将此类工具归类为高风险。在ALS诊断中不加批判地采用消费级人工智能构成公共卫生风险。临床医生、监管机构和开发者必须合作，确保人工智能安全、合乎道德地为患者服务。
items.frontierRationale: 该文聚焦2026年最新AI监管动态（欧盟AI法案）与ALS诊断交叉点，具有新近性和转化价值，提示AI工具在ALS临床路径中的风险管控需求。

items.title: Tofersen Treatment in SOD1 -ALS: Real-World Evidence from a Retrospective Multicenter Study in France (FORSLA Study).
items.summary: To evaluate the effectiveness of Tofersen in patients with superoxide dismutase 1 gene ( SOD1-ALS ) patients in France in a real-world setting, using disease progression within patient comparisons and with a historical cohort. Patients with SOD1 -ALS were included from across 19 French FILSLAN network centers. Baseline was defined as the treatment initiation date. Main endpoints were the ALSFRS-R progression rate and plasmatic neurofilament light chain (NfL) levels at baseline and 12 months after baseline. In the Tofersen Cohort (N=46), within-group comparisons showed that the mean ALS functional rating scale revised (ALSFRS-R) progression rate slowed from 0.53 ± 0.5 at baseline to 0.22 ± 0.3 point/month at 12 months ( P =.006). NfL levels significantly decreased from 89.0 ± 9.0 pg/ml at baseline to 29.2 ± 19.5.5 at 12 months ( P =.004). Exploratory comparisons with a propensity score (PS) matched historical cohort (39 matched pairs) using a mixed-effects model, ALSFRS-R progression rate at baseline, 6 months, and 12 months after baseline, showed no statistically significant differences between groups P =.30, whereas longitudinal ALSFRS-R scores differed significantly between groups (time-treatment interaction P =.006). The mean survival of the PS matched population was longer in the Tofersen Cohort (42.6 months) than the Historical Cohort (31.8 months) P =.004. Time-dependent adjusted cox analysis showed that Tofersen was associated with a reduction in mortality risk (adjusted HR=0.34; 95% CI, 0.12-0.91; P =.03). Tofersen seems to be associated with slower functional decline and reduced NfL levels. While limitations of retrospective design and ALSFRS-R sensitivity must be acknowledged, these findings provide real-world evidence suggesting a clinical benefit of Tofersen.
items.titleZh: Tofersen治疗SOD1-ALS：法国多中心回顾性研究的真实世界证据（FORSLA研究）
items.summaryZh: 这项法国多中心回顾性研究（FORSLA）分析了46名接受Tofersen治疗的SOD1-ALS患者，发现治疗12个月后，功能衰退速度（ALSFRS-R进展率）显著减缓，血浆NfL水平显著下降。与历史队列相比，Tofersen治疗与更长的生存期和更低的死亡风险相关。研究为Tofersen在真实世界中的临床获益提供了支持性证据，但受限于回顾性设计。
items.insight: 该研究是首个在法国真实世界环境中评估Tofersen治疗SOD1-ALS的多中心证据，不仅验证了临床试验中观察到的NfL下降和功能改善，还首次报告了生存期获益，为SOD1-ALS的靶向治疗提供了重要的临床实践参考。

items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在评估Tofersen在法国真实世界环境中对超氧化物歧化酶1基因（SOD1-ALS）患者的疗效，采用患者内疾病进展比较及与历史队列的比较。研究纳入来自法国19个FILSLAN网络中心的SOD1-ALS患者。基线定义为治疗开始日期。主要终点为基线和基线后12个月的ALSFRS-R进展率和血浆神经丝轻链（NfL）水平。在Tofersen队列（N=46）中，组内比较显示，平均ALSFRS-R进展率从基线的0.53±0.5点/月减缓至12个月时的0.22±0.3点/月（P=0.006）。NfL水平从基线的89.0±9.0 pg/ml显著下降至12个月时的29.2±19.5 pg/ml（P=0.004）。与倾向评分匹配的历史队列（39对匹配）的探索性比较（使用混合效应模型）显示，基线、6个月和12个月后的ALSFRS-R进展率组间无统计学显著差异（P=0.30），而纵向ALSFRS-R评分组间差异显著（时间-治疗交互作用P=0.006）。倾向评分匹配人群的平均生存期在Tofersen队列（42.6个月）长于历史队列（31.8个月）（P=0.004）。时间依赖性校正Cox分析显示，Tofersen与死亡风险降低相关（校正HR=0.34；95% CI，0.12-0.91；P=0.03）。Tofersen似乎与功能衰退减缓及NfL水平降低相关。尽管必须承认回顾性设计和ALSFRS-R敏感性的局限性，这些发现提供了支持Tofersen临床获益的真实世界证据。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究提供了Tofersen在真实世界中的最新生存期获益证据，直接关联ALS精准治疗转化价值。

items.title: Gut microbiota and brain health: Disease-specific pathways and emerging therapeutic strategies.
items.summary: The microbiota-gut-brain axis (MGBA) has emerged as a dynamic, bidirectional communication system linking the gastrointestinal tract and the central nervous system (CNS) through neural, immune, endocrine, and metabolic mechanisms. Increasing evidence indicates that alterations in gut microbial communities are associated with a wide range of neurological disorders; however, the strength of this association varies across diseases, and many mechanistic observations still rely predominantly on experimental models rather than human studies. This review provides an overview of current evidence regarding the role of the gut microbiota in maintaining CNS homeostasis, with particular emphasis on intestinal barrier function, immune modulation, vagal and enteric communication, and the generation of biologically active microbial metabolites, including short-chain fatty acids, bile acids, and neurotransmitter-related compounds. Studies in both clinical and experimental settings have reported disease-specific microbial signatures in conditions such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, multiple sclerosis, autism spectrum disorders, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In parallel, microbiota-directed interventions-including probiotics, prebiotics, dietary approaches, fecal microbiota transplantation, and strategies targeting microbial metabolites-have produced encouraging findings in preclinical studies and early-stage clinical investigations. Nevertheless, considerable heterogeneity in study populations, experimental methodologies, and therapeutic protocols continues to limit the translation of these findings into routine clinical practice. Collectively, current evidence supports the MGBA as a valuable framework for understanding neurological diseases while underscoring the need for rigorously designed longitudinal studies and well-controlled clinical trials to define its therapeutic relevance better.

items.titleZh: 肠道微生物群与大脑健康：疾病特异性通路与新兴治疗策略
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述总结了肠道微生物群通过肠-脑轴影响中枢神经系统健康的证据，指出不同神经退行性疾病（包括ALS）存在特定的微生物特征。虽然益生菌、饮食干预等策略在早期研究中显示出潜力，但作者强调目前多数机制证据来自动物模型，人类数据有限，且研究异质性大，尚不能直接用于临床。
items.insight: 该综述系统梳理了ALS等神经退行性疾病中肠道微生物群的变化及其可能机制，为ALS研究者提供了疾病特异性微生物靶点的全景图，并指出了未来纵向研究和临床试验的设计方向。

aiRead.keyFinding: ALS等神经退行性疾病存在疾病特异性的肠道微生物特征，微生物靶向干预在临床前和早期临床研究中显示出前景，但证据尚不充分。
aiRead.limitation: 综述依赖现有文献，多数机制证据来自动物模型，人类研究异质性大，且未提供原始数据。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注针对ALS的粪便微生物群移植或特定益生菌的随机对照试验结果，以及纵向队列中微生物变化与疾病进展的关联研究。

items.abstractZh: 微生物群-肠-脑轴（MGBA）已成为一个动态的双向通讯系统，通过神经、免疫、内分泌和代谢机制连接胃肠道与中枢神经系统（CNS）。越来越多的证据表明，肠道微生物群落的改变与多种神经系统疾病相关；然而，这种关联的强度因疾病而异，许多机制性观察仍主要依赖于实验模型而非人类研究。本综述概述了肠道微生物群在维持CNS稳态中作用的现有证据，特别强调肠道屏障功能、免疫调节、迷走神经和肠神经系统通讯，以及生物活性微生物代谢产物（包括短链脂肪酸、胆汁酸和神经递质相关化合物）的产生。临床和实验研究均报告了阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、多发性硬化症、自闭症谱系障碍和肌萎缩侧索硬化等疾病中的疾病特异性微生物特征。与此同时，针对微生物群的干预措施——包括益生菌、益生元、饮食方法、粪便微生物群移植以及靶向微生物代谢产物的策略——在临床前研究和早期临床研究中取得了令人鼓舞的结果。然而，研究人群、实验方法和治疗方案中的显著异质性仍限制了这些发现向常规临床实践的转化。总体而言，现有证据支持MGBA作为理解神经系统疾病的有价值框架，同时强调需要严格设计的纵向研究和良好对照的临床试验，以更好地确定其治疗相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，整合了最新的肠-脑轴研究，强调了ALS等疾病的微生物靶向治疗潜力，具有明确的ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Macrophage responses to and elevated antibody levels against Chlorovirus ATCV-1 in ALS patients.
items.summary: Acanthocystis turfacea chlorella virus 1 (ATCV-1) is a giant virus that is part of the human oral microvirome. Previously we showed that ATCV-1 infects mouse macrophages, stimulates production of inflammatory cytokines, and accelerates motor neuron disease in the Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) model SOD1-G93A transgenic mice. This, coupled with significantly elevated levels of serum IgG1 antibody to ATCV-1 in ALS patients compared with healthy controls, suggests involvement of ATCV-1 in ALS. Herein, using serum and CSF from a different ALS cohort we again show elevated antibodies to ATCV-1 in ALS patients compared with healthy controls. To assess ATCV-1 in human macrophages, we challenged immature (IMM), M0, M1, and M2 human THP-1 macrophage cells containing an Interferon Stimulated Response Element (ISRE) promoter-reporter with ATCV-1 or its Major Capsid protein (MCP) glycans. ATCV-1 infected M1 THP-1 to a greater degree than IMM, M0, or M2 THP-1. The initial high ISRE-promoter activity of M1 THP-1 was suppressed by the MCP-Glycans of ATCV-1. M0, but not IMM or M2 THP-1 produced IL-6 in response to ATCV-1 or its MCP-glycan, while high levels of IL-6 from unchallenged M1 THP-1 increased further by ATCV-1 or its MCP glycan. In contrast, ATCV-1 or its MCP-Glycan significantly reduced the high levels of IL-10 produced by M2 THP-1. Thus, antibody to ATCV-1 in ALS patients and the susceptibility of human M1 macrophages to ATCV-1 infection with boosted inflammatory cytokine and diminished anti-inflammatory cytokine production suggest that ATCV-1 may contribute to ALS motor neuron disease.

items.titleZh: ALS患者中巨噬细胞对Chlorovirus ATCV-1的反应及抗体水平升高
items.summaryZh: 这项研究在独立ALS患者队列中再次证实了针对ATCV-1病毒的抗体水平升高。体外实验显示，ATCV-1优先感染促炎型M1巨噬细胞，并增强其炎症因子（IL-6）产生，同时抑制抗炎型M2巨噬细胞的IL-10分泌。这些结果支持ATCV-1感染可能通过加剧神经炎症参与ALS病理过程。
items.insight: 该研究为环境病毒（ATCV-1）参与ALS发病提供了新的独立队列证据，并首次在人巨噬细胞亚型水平揭示了ATCV-1感染与炎症失衡之间的具体机制联系，提示口腔微生物组中的病毒成分可能作为ALS的疾病修饰因素，值得关注其作为治疗靶点或风险标志物的潜力。

items.abstractZh: Acanthocystis turfacea chlorella virus 1 (ATCV-1) 是一种巨型病毒，属于人类口腔微生物组的一部分。此前研究表明，ATCV-1可感染小鼠巨噬细胞，刺激炎症细胞因子产生，并加速肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）模型SOD1-G93A转基因小鼠的运动神经元疾病进展。此外，与健康对照相比，ALS患者血清中针对ATCV-1的IgG1抗体水平显著升高，提示ATCV-1可能参与ALS发病。本研究使用来自不同ALS队列的血清和脑脊液，再次证实ALS患者中针对ATCV-1的抗体水平高于健康对照。为评估ATCV-1对人巨噬细胞的作用，研究者使用含有干扰素刺激反应元件（ISRE）启动子报告基因的未成熟（IMM）、M0、M1和M2人THP-1巨噬细胞，分别以ATCV-1或其主要衣壳蛋白（MCP）聚糖进行刺激。结果显示，ATCV-1对M1 THP-1细胞的感染程度高于IMM、M0或M2 THP-1细胞。M1 THP-1细胞初始较高的ISRE启动子活性被ATCV-1的MCP聚糖所抑制。M0（而非IMM或M2）THP-1细胞在ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖刺激下产生IL-6，而未受刺激的M1 THP-1细胞本身产生的高水平IL-6在ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖作用下进一步增加。相反，ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖显著降低了M2 THP-1细胞产生的高水平IL-10。因此，ALS患者中针对ATCV-1的抗体以及人M1巨噬细胞对ATCV-1感染的易感性（伴随炎症细胞因子增强和抗炎细胞因子减少）提示ATCV-1可能促进ALS运动神经元疾病的发展。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究在独立队列中重复验证了ATCV-1抗体与ALS的关联，并首次阐明其对人M1/M2巨噬细胞亚型差异性的炎症调节作用，具有直接的ALS病因相关性。

items.title: Multiplex Panel Detects Glial and Inflammatory Biomarker Signatures in Sporadic and C9orf72-ALS.
items.summary: CSF proteomics has emerged as a valuable strategy for identifying diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). However, the limited availability and volumes of CSF samples restrict the broader clinical application of CSF-based biomarker panels. To address this challenge, we investigated whether the novel nucleic acid-linked immuno-sandwich assay (NULISA) multiplex platform-capable of quantifying multiple neural, glial, and inflammatory markers from minimal biofluid volumes-could validate previously proposed biomarkers and identify additional candidates relevant to ALS. Using this platform, we measured a targeted panel of 131 biomarkers in cohorts of patients with C9orf72-associated ALS, sporadic ALS (sALS), and matched healthy controls. The 6 markers neurofilament heavy chain (NEFH) and neurofilament light chain (NEFL), chitinases-particularly chitotriosidase-1 (CHIT1) and chitinase-3-like protein-1 (CHI3L1), and chemokines CCL2 and CCL3 were significantly elevated in both ALS groups compared with controls. These biomarkers correlated with disease progression and demonstrated strong diagnostic performance when combined into aggregate scores, as reflected by a high area under the receiver operating characteristic curve for ALS. Notably, C9orf72-ALS patients exhibited higher levels of the oxidative stress-related markers PRDX6 and ENO2, compared with sALS patients, suggesting a genotype-specific molecular signature. Overall, our findings support the use of a multiplexed panel of diverse, inflammatory, glial, and neurodegeneration-associated biomarkers as a complementary diagnostic and prognostic tool alongside established measurements of neurofilaments. This approach may enhance biomarker robustness while minimizing CSF volume requirements, thereby improving clinical feasibility in ALS research and care.
items.titleZh: 多重检测面板在散发性与C9orf72相关ALS中检测到胶质细胞和炎症生物标志物特征
items.summaryZh: 这项研究利用NULISA多重平台，在少量脑脊液样本中同时检测131种生物标志物，发现ALS患者（包括散发性与C9orf72相关）中神经丝（NEFL、NEFH）、几丁质酶（CHIT1、CHI3L1）和趋化因子（CCL2、CCL3）显著升高，且与疾病进展相关。C9orf72-ALS患者还表现出独特的氧化应激标志物（PRDX6、ENO2）升高。该面板有望成为ALS诊断和预后的补充工具，并减少样本体积需求。
items.insight: 这项研究对ALS研究者具有重要意义，因为它验证了NULISA平台在极少量脑脊液中同时检测多种生物标志物的可行性，不仅确认了已知的神经丝和几丁质酶标志物，还发现了C9orf72-ALS特有的氧化应激相关分子特征，为基因型特异性生物标志物和病理机制研究提供了新线索。

aiRead.studyType: 观察性临床研究（生物标志物验证）
aiRead.keyFinding: NULISA平台可检测ALS脑脊液中神经丝、几丁质酶和趋化因子等6种标志物显著升高，且C9orf72-ALS患者呈现PRDX6和ENO2升高的基因型特异性特征。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量可能有限，且未提供具体队列规模；研究为横断面设计，预后价值需纵向验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该平台在更大队列中的验证，以及PRDX6和ENO2在C9orf72-ALS中的机制研究。

items.abstractZh: 脑脊液蛋白质组学已成为识别肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）诊断和预后生物标志物的有价值策略。然而，脑脊液样本的有限可用性和体积限制了基于脑脊液的生物标志物面板的更广泛临床应用。为应对这一挑战，我们研究了新型核酸连接免疫夹心测定（NULISA）多重平台——该平台能够从极少量生物流体中定量多种神经、胶质和炎症标志物——是否能够验证先前提出的生物标志物并识别与ALS相关的其他候选标志物。使用该平台，我们在C9orf72相关ALS、散发性ALS（sALS）和匹配的健康对照队列中测量了131种生物标志物的靶向面板。与对照组相比，两个ALS组中6种标志物显著升高：神经丝重链（NEFH）和神经丝轻链（NEFL）、几丁质酶——特别是壳三糖苷酶-1（CHIT1）和几丁质酶-3样蛋白-1（CHI3L1），以及趋化因子CCL2和CCL3。这些生物标志物与疾病进展相关，并在组合成聚合评分时表现出强大的诊断性能，如ALS的受试者工作特征曲线下面积较高所示。值得注意的是，与sALS患者相比，C9orf72-ALS患者表现出更高水平的氧化应激相关标志物PRDX6和ENO2，提示存在基因型特异性分子特征。总体而言，我们的研究结果支持使用包含多种炎症、胶质和神经退行性相关生物标志物的多重面板，作为已建立的神经丝测量的补充诊断和预后工具。这种方法可能增强生物标志物的稳健性，同时最小化脑脊液体积需求，从而提高ALS研究和护理中的临床可行性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究采用新型NULISA多重平台，在极低样本体积下实现高多重生物标志物检测，并揭示C9orf72-ALS特异性分子特征，具有直接的ALS转化价值。

items.title: Association of Military Branch and Rank With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Incidence Among United States Veterans.
items.summary: Military service is one of the most consistent risk factors for the development of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), but little is known about what aspects of military service matter. Understanding the distribution of ALS risk in military personnel may help identify key risk factors. We aimed to ascertain the association of United States (US) military branch and rank with incident ALS. We conducted a longitudinal cohort study including all veterans with a Veterans Health Administration encounter from January 1, 2000, through October 1, 2024, and more than 2 years of follow-up. Incident ALS was identified through medical records. Exposures included military branch (Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, Coast Guard, or multiple branches), military rank (officer, enlisted, or both), and length of service. Risk was estimated with Cox proportional hazards models, controlled for age, adjusted for race/ethnicity, and stratified by sex. The analytic sample comprised 9,157,938 men (13,935 incident ALS cases, mean age = 56.9 years) and 784,941 women (484 cases, mean age = 42.4 at start of follow up). Among men, compared with service in the Army, service in the Air Force (hazard ratio [HR] = 1.29, 95% CI 1.23-1.35), Navy (HR = 1.15, 95% CI 1.10-1.20), and Coast Guard (HR = 1.26, 95% CI 1.06-1.50) was associated with higher rates of ALS and service in the Marines a lower rate (HR = 0.78, 95% CI 0.68-0.88). Officers had higher rates than enlisted personnel (men, HR = 1.64, 95% CI 1.53-1.74; women, HR = 1.72, 95% CI 1.31-2.27). Longer service was associated with lower rates of ALS. In age-stratified models, differences in hazard rates between Army veterans and Air Force, Navy, and Coast Guard veterans were greatest for the youngest men (17-61 years, HR range = 1.26 to 1.51) and smallest for the oldest (>75-104 years, HR range = 0.99 to 1.12). ALS rates varied considerably by branch and rank in the US military, with larger differences among younger veterans. Officers and those serving in the Air Force, Navy, or Coast Guard may incur exposure to military environments that increase risk of ALS. It is imperative to identify relevant exposures to reduce harm to service members and, potentially, civilians with similar exposures.
items.titleZh: 美国退伍军人中军种与军衔与肌萎缩侧索硬化发病率的关联
items.summaryZh: 这项针对美国退伍军人的大型纵向研究发现，军种和军衔与ALS发病风险显著相关。空军、海军和海岸警卫队服役者风险高于陆军，而海军陆战队风险较低；军官风险高于士兵；服役年限越长风险反而越低。这些差异在年轻退伍军人中尤为明显。研究提示特定军事环境暴露可能增加ALS风险，但具体暴露因素尚待识别。
items.insight: 这项研究是迄今规模最大的关于军事服役细节与ALS风险关联的队列研究之一，覆盖近千万退伍军人。它首次系统揭示了军种和军衔对ALS风险的差异化影响，为缩小ALS环境风险因素的搜索范围提供了关键线索，对理解ALS病因和军人健康防护具有重要价值。

items.abstractZh: 服兵役是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）最一致的风险因素之一，但关于兵役的哪些方面重要，目前知之甚少。了解军人中ALS风险的分布可能有助于识别关键风险因素。我们旨在确定美国军种和军衔与偶发性ALS的关联。我们进行了一项纵向队列研究，纳入2000年1月1日至2024年10月1日期间所有在退伍军人健康管理局有就诊记录且随访超过2年的退伍军人。偶发性ALS通过医疗记录识别。暴露因素包括军种（陆军、海军、空军、海军陆战队、海岸警卫队或多个军种）、军衔（军官、士兵或两者）以及服役年限。风险使用Cox比例风险模型估计，控制年龄，调整种族/民族，并按性别分层。分析样本包括9,157,938名男性（13,935例偶发性ALS病例，平均年龄56.9岁）和784,941名女性（484例病例，随访开始时平均年龄42.4岁）。在男性中，与陆军服役相比，空军（风险比[HR]=1.29，95% CI 1.23-1.35）、海军（HR=1.15，95% CI 1.10-1.20）和海岸警卫队（HR=1.26，95% CI 1.06-1.50）服役与较高的ALS发病率相关，而海军陆战队服役与较低的发病率相关（HR=0.78，95% CI 0.68-0.88）。军官的发病率高于士兵（男性，HR=1.64，95% CI 1.53-1.74；女性，HR=1.72，95% CI 1.31-2.27）。较长的服役年限与较低的ALS发病率相关。在按年龄分层的模型中，陆军退伍军人与空军、海军和海岸警卫队退伍军人之间的风险差异在年轻男性中最大（17-61岁，HR范围=1.26至1.51），在年长男性中最小（>75-104岁，HR范围=0.99至1.12）。美国军队中ALS发病率因军种和军衔而有显著差异，年轻退伍军人中的差异更大。军官以及在空军、海军或海岸警卫队服役的人员可能暴露于增加ALS风险的军事环境中。识别相关暴露以减少对服役人员以及可能具有类似暴露的平民的伤害至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2000-2024年近千万退伍军人的最新纵向数据，首次系统量化了军种和军衔对ALS风险的差异化影响，具有直接的ALS病因学转化价值。

items.title: Lessons from a systematic review of family-based studies in ALS.
items.summary: ALS is genetically heterogeneous, with many causal genes identified through family-based gene-discovery studies. To evaluate this progress, we systematically reviewed these studies and identified unresolved genomic regions across five pedigrees. Reexamination resolved two pedigrees, nominating FUS and SYNE1 as the causal genes. The remaining three pedigrees exhibited linkage to four unresolved regions, which we reanalyzed using large-scale genetic datasets. We found no convincing evidence for new ALS-causing variants in these regions. These unresolved regions originated from complex pedigrees-consanguineous, isolated, or containing only a few affected individuals-whereas successful linkage was observed in larger, multigenerational families with ALS. Our findings confirm that family-based methods are robust in typical ALS pedigrees but lack power in small pedigrees with few affected individuals or in phenotypically heterogeneous families. Given these challenges and the rare-variant architecture of ALS, we propose a 'super-pedigree' framework to identify extended families with ALS to discover shared genetic risk factors and help develop gene-based therapies.
items.titleZh: ALS家族性研究的系统综述：经验与教训
items.summaryZh: 这篇系统综述评估了基于家系的ALS基因发现研究的成效。在五个未解决的家系中，重新分析解决了两个（分别指向FUS和SYNE1），但其余三个复杂家系（近亲、隔离或病例少）未能找到新的致病变异。作者认为，家系连锁方法在典型多代大家系中有效，但在小家系或表型异质性家族中效力不足。为此，他们提出“超级家系”框架，通过整合扩展家族来发现共享遗传风险因素，为基因靶向治疗铺路。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS遗传学方法学提供了重要反思：传统家系连锁分析在复杂或小型家系中可能失效，而“超级家系”框架代表了一种应对罕见变异架构的新策略，对ALS研究者设计遗传发现研究具有直接指导意义。

aiRead.keyFinding: 家系连锁分析在典型多代ALS家系中有效，但在复杂或小型家系中效力不足；重新分析解决了两个家系，分别指向FUS和SYNE1，其余三个家系未发现新致病变异。

items.abstractZh: ALS具有遗传异质性，许多致病基因是通过基于家族（家系）的基因发现研究鉴定出来的。为评估这一进展，我们系统回顾了这些研究，并在五个家系中识别出未解决的基因组区域。重新检验解决了其中两个家系，分别提名FUS和SYNE1为致病基因。其余三个家系与四个未解决区域存在连锁，我们使用大规模遗传数据集对其进行了重新分析，未发现这些区域中存在新的ALS致病变异的有力证据。这些未解决区域源于复杂家系——近亲婚配、隔离人群或仅含少数患病个体的家系——而成功的连锁分析则见于更大、多代且含ALS患者的家系。我们的研究结果证实，基于家族的方法在典型ALS家系中是稳健的，但在患病个体少的小家系或表型异质性家族中效力不足。鉴于这些挑战以及ALS的罕见变异架构，我们提出一个“超级家系”框架，以识别ALS扩展家族，发现共享的遗传风险因素，并帮助开发基于基因的疗法。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于最新系统综述数据，提出“超级家系”这一创新框架，直接回应ALS罕见变异遗传架构下的方法学瓶颈，具有明确的转化价值。

items.title: The selenium and vitamin E cancer prevention trial (SELECT): a secondary, post-intervention analysis on potential excess chronic disease incidence induced by selenium administration.
items.summary: The potential for trace amounts of selenium supplements to prevent prostate cancer and other neoplasms was studied in SELECT, a randomized trial conducted in North America for 7-12 years. 34 887 eligible men age 55 or older were assigned to take either 200 μg selenium from L-selenomethionine, 400 IU vitamin E, both selenium and vitamin E, or placebo. The trial was stopped for futility and concerns about adverse effects. Subsequently, we used incidence and mortality data from Medicare through 2019 and the National Death Index through 2024 to investigate the extent to which selenium administration was associated with increased long-term risk of cancer and neurodegenerative disease, during 341 697 person-years of follow-up. Lung cancer showed little increased risk. Associations were near null for leukemia, non-Hodgkin lymphoma and Parkinson's disease, and there was a lower risk for melanoma and colorectal cancer. In contrast, we found a higher risk for Hodgkin lymphoma, multiple myeloma and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, which has been associated with selenium overexposure in some nonexperimental studies. Though these latter associations were based on few cases, they were consistent with findings from a range of other studies, possibly indicating long-term adverse effects of this organic selenium compound. (Registration no. NCT00006392).

items.titleZh: 硒和维生素E癌症预防试验（SELECT）：一项关于硒补充可能诱发慢性疾病超额风险的次要、干预后分析
items.summaryZh: 这项研究重新分析了SELECT试验的长期随访数据，发现硒补充与霍奇金淋巴瘤、多发性骨髓瘤和ALS风险升高相关，但病例数较少；肺癌、白血病等风险无显著增加。结果提示硒补充可能具有长期不良效应，但需谨慎解读。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS研究者提供了来自大型随机对照试验长期随访的流行病学证据，提示硒暴露可能是ALS的潜在风险因素，值得关注硒在ALS发病机制中的可能作用。

aiRead.keyFinding: 硒补充与ALS风险升高相关，但病例数少；其他癌症和帕金森病风险无显著增加。
aiRead.limitation: ALS病例数少，关联可能受偶然性影响；研究为事后分析，未预先设定ALS为主要终点。

items.abstractZh: SELECT是一项在北美进行的随机试验，持续7-12年，研究了微量硒补充剂预防前列腺癌和其他肿瘤的可能性。34887名年龄55岁或以上的合格男性被分配服用200 μg L-硒代蛋氨酸、400 IU维生素E、硒和维生素E联合，或安慰剂。该试验因无效性和不良事件担忧而提前终止。随后，我们利用截至2019年的Medicare发病率和死亡率数据以及截至2024年的国家死亡指数数据，在341697人年的随访中，调查了硒补充与癌症和神经退行性疾病长期风险增加之间的关联程度。肺癌风险增加不明显。白血病、非霍奇金淋巴瘤和帕金森病的关联接近零，黑色素瘤和结直肠癌风险较低。相反，我们发现霍奇金淋巴瘤、多发性骨髓瘤和肌萎缩侧索硬化症的风险较高，后者在一些非实验性研究中与硒过量暴露相关。尽管这些关联基于少数病例，但与其他一系列研究的结果一致，可能表明这种有机硒化合物的长期不良效应。（注册号：NCT00006392）
items.frontierRationale: 基于大型随机对照试验的长期随访数据，新近分析硒补充与ALS风险的关联，具有直接的ALS病因学相关性。

items.source: Journal of neuroimmune pharmacology : the official journal of the Society on NeuroImmune Pharmacology
items.title: cGAS-STING as a Neuroimmune Traffic Molecule: Unraveling Pathogenic Mechanisms and Therapeutic Potential in Neurological Disorders.
items.summary: The cyclic GMP-AMP synthase-stimulator of interferon genes (cGAS-STING) pathway is an essential cytosolic DNA-sensing system that plays an important role in the regulation of innate immune and inflammatory responses in the central nervous system (CNS). It was first discovered as a promising antiviral defense cascade and has since been shown to execute broader functions in neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration. The pathway can become hyperactive with the release of endogenous DNA from damaged nuclei, mitochondria, or genomic instability, leading to chronic production of type I interferon (TI-IFN), various pro-inflammatory cytokines, and eventually contributing to chronic neuroinflammatory diseases. Recent studies have found that dysregulated cGAS-STING signaling is associated with several neurological disorders, such as Alzheimer's disease (AD), Parkinson's disease (PD), Huntington's disease (HD), amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), traumatic brain injury (TBI), stroke, and age-related neurodegeneration. In the CNS, chronic activation of this pathway leads to activation of microglia, oxidative stress, breakdown of the blood-brain barrier (BBB), impaired function of the synapses, and neuronal death. Mitochondrial dysfunction and cytosolic release of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) further promote inflammatory signaling, thus perpetuating neurodegeneration. This review highlights the molecular and pathological mechanisms of cGAS-STING signaling in a broader aspect of neurological disorders and appraises the novel therapeutics already under development to inhibit this pathway to regulate neuroinflammation and enhance neurological outcomes.
items.titleZh: cGAS-STING作为神经免疫交通分子：揭示神经系统疾病的致病机制与治疗潜力
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述聚焦cGAS-STING通路在神经系统疾病中的作用，指出该通路在ALS等多种神经退行性疾病中被异常激活，导致慢性神经炎症和神经元损伤。文章总结了cGAS-STING作为潜在治疗靶点的前景，并讨论了正在开发的抑制剂。对于ALS研究者，该通路可能解释部分ALS病例中神经炎症的驱动机制，并为抗炎治疗提供新思路。
items.insight: 该综述系统梳理了cGAS-STING通路在ALS等神经退行性疾病中的致病机制，强调了线粒体DNA释放与神经炎症的关联，为ALS的炎症靶向治疗提供了理论基础，值得关注其后续临床转化进展。

aiRead.keyFinding: cGAS-STING通路在ALS等多种神经退行性疾病中过度激活，驱动慢性神经炎症，是潜在治疗靶点。
aiRead.limitation: 综述基于现有文献，缺乏原始实验数据，且cGAS-STING抑制剂在ALS中的临床证据尚不充分。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注cGAS-STING抑制剂在ALS动物模型中的疗效数据，以及早期临床试验结果。

items.abstractZh: 环状GMP-AMP合酶-干扰素基因刺激因子（cGAS-STING）通路是重要的胞质DNA传感系统，在中枢神经系统（CNS）固有免疫和炎症反应调控中发挥关键作用。该通路最初被发现为抗病毒防御级联反应，随后被证明在神经炎症和神经退行性变中具有更广泛的功能。当受损细胞核、线粒体释放的内源性DNA或基因组不稳定导致该通路过度激活时，会引发I型干扰素（TI-IFN）和多种促炎细胞因子的慢性产生，最终促成慢性神经炎症疾病。近期研究发现，cGAS-STING信号失调与多种神经系统疾病相关，如阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）、亨廷顿病（HD）、肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）、创伤性脑损伤（TBI）、卒中和年龄相关神经退行性变。在CNS中，该通路的慢性激活导致小胶质细胞活化、氧化应激、血脑屏障（BBB）破坏、突触功能受损和神经元死亡。线粒体功能障碍和胞质线粒体DNA（mtDNA）释放进一步促进炎症信号，从而加剧神经退行性变。本综述强调了cGAS-STING信号在神经系统疾病中的分子和病理机制，并评估了正在开发的抑制该通路以调节神经炎症和改善神经结局的新型治疗策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，整合了cGAS-STING通路在ALS等疾病中的最新机制研究，并评估了在研抑制剂，具有明确的ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Blood SOD1 Activity in ALS Patients Receiving Tofersen Treatment.
items.summary: The antisense oligonucleotide tofersen is the first disease-modifying drug for SOD1-related amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and was approved because of its ability to reduce SOD1 protein and neurofilament levels. The effect of tofersen on SOD1 activity is unclear but of clinical relevance because homozygous SOD1 mutations, linked to reduced SOD1 activity, cause severe motor neuron impairment and tofersen-induced reduction could be deleterious. Therefore, monitoring of SOD1 activity is urgently needed. SOD1 activity was analyzed in blood samples from a discovery (n = 120) and a validation cohort (n = 208), including controls, patients with sporadic ALS (sALS), C9orf72 mutation carriers (c9ALS), asymptomatic (SOD1-asym), and symptomatic SOD1 mutation carriers (SOD1-ALS). SOD1 activity was characterized in 18 patients receiving tofersen treatment. SOD1 activity was significantly lower in both SOD1-asym (median = 7.5 U/mg, interquartile range [IQR] = 7.0-9.0 U/mg) and SOD1-ALS (median = 7.9 U/mg, IQR = 7.1-9.1 U/mg) relative to controls (median = 9.2 U/mg, IQR = 8.9-10.0 U/mg, p < 0.0001), c9ALS (median = 9.4 U/mg, IQR = 8.9-10.2 U/mg, p < 0.0001) and sALS (median 9.5 U/mg, IQR 8.8-9.9 U/mg, p < 0.0001). SOD1 activity was significantly lower in individuals with deleterious SOD1 variants than in individuals with neutral variants. During tofersen treatment, neurofilament and SOD1 protein levels decreased, whereas SOD1 activity remained stable. The data indicate that the positive tofersen treatment effect is independent of SOD1 activity. Lower SOD1 activity is specific to SOD1-ALS, already present in the asymptomatic phase and depends on the mutation type. Future studies should determine whether tofersen treatment affects cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) SOD1 activity. ANN NEUROL 2026.
items.titleZh: 接受Tofersen治疗的ALS患者血液SOD1活性
items.summaryZh: 这项研究分析了ALS患者血液中的SOD1酶活性，发现SOD1突变携带者（无论有无症状）的SOD1活性显著低于健康对照、散发性ALS和C9orf72突变患者。在接受tofersen治疗期间，虽然SOD1蛋白和神经丝水平下降，但SOD1活性保持稳定，提示tofersen的疗效不依赖于SOD1活性的改变。研究还发现SOD1活性降低与突变类型有关，有害突变导致更低的活性。
items.insight: 该研究首次系统评估了tofersen治疗对血液SOD1活性的影响，证实治疗期间SOD1活性保持稳定，为tofersen的临床安全性提供了重要依据，同时揭示了SOD1活性作为SOD1-ALS特异性生物标志物的潜力，对患者分层和治疗监测具有指导意义。

items.abstractZh: 反义寡核苷酸tofersen是首个针对SOD1相关肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的疾病修饰药物，因其能够降低SOD1蛋白和神经丝水平而获批。Tofersen对SOD1活性的影响尚不清楚，但具有临床相关性，因为与SOD1活性降低相关的纯合SOD1突变会导致严重的运动神经元损伤，而tofersen诱导的SOD1降低可能是有害的。因此，迫切需要对SOD1活性进行监测。研究分析了来自发现队列（n=120）和验证队列（n=208）的血液样本中的SOD1活性，包括对照组、散发性ALS（sALS）患者、C9orf72突变携带者（c9ALS）、无症状（SOD1-asym）和有症状的SOD1突变携带者（SOD1-ALS）。对18名接受tofersen治疗的患者进行了SOD1活性表征。与对照组（中位数=9.2 U/mg，IQR=8.9-10.0 U/mg，p<0.0001）、c9ALS（中位数=9.4 U/mg，IQR=8.9-10.2 U/mg，p<0.0001）和sALS（中位数9.5 U/mg，IQR 8.8-9.9 U/mg，p<0.0001）相比，SOD1-asym（中位数=7.5 U/mg，IQR=7.0-9.0 U/mg）和SOD1-ALS（中位数=7.9 U/mg，IQR=7.1-9.1 U/mg）的SOD1活性显著较低。携带有害SOD1变异的个体SOD1活性显著低于携带中性变异的个体。在tofersen治疗期间，神经丝和SOD1蛋白水平下降，而SOD1活性保持稳定。数据表明，tofersen的积极治疗效果与SOD1活性无关。较低的SOD1活性是SOD1-ALS的特异性表现，在无症状阶段就已存在，并取决于突变类型。未来的研究应确定tofersen治疗是否影响脑脊液（CSF）SOD1活性。ANN NEUROL 2026。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究直接关联最新获批的SOD1-ALS靶向药物tofersen，提供了关于其作用机制和安全性关键问题的首批临床数据，具有高度ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: LXR Pathway Activation by T0901317: A Novel Potential Experimental Strategy for ALS-Related Cognitive and Motor Impairments via Suppression of Necroptosis-associated RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL Markers.
items.summary: To investigate the effects and mechanism of a synthetic LXR agonist, T0901317, on neuronal necroptosis-related signaling pathways in NSC-34 mouse neuronal cells transfected with the TDP-43-A315T plasmid, TDP-43-A315T transgenic mice of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). SWATH proteinomics analysis was used to compare ALS patients with cognitive impairment (CI) and non-cognitive impairment (NOCI). TDP-43 abnormal aggregation and necroptosis-related protein expression were assessed with immunofluorescence and western blotting, while apoptosis and inflammatory cytokines were measured through TUNEL assay and ELISA, muscle and motor neuron degeneration were examined with H&E and Toluidine Blue staining. Additionally, the Y-maze and Rotarod tests were used to evaluate cognitive and motor functions. Our study indicates that the LXR pathway was more downregulated in the ALS patients with cognitive impairment. RIPK1, p-RIPK3, and p-MLKL protein levels were upregulated in the TDP-43-A315T plasmid-transfected neuron cells and the TDP-43-A315T transgenic mouse model. The LXR agonist T0901317 reduced the abnormal aggregation of TDP-43 protein and downregulated the protein levels of RIPK1, p-RIPK3, and p-MLKL in vivo and in vitro. Furthermore, T0901317 attenuated motor neuron death and ameliorated muscle degeneration in TDP-43-A315T mice. T0901317 significantly prolonged survival, ameliorated cognitive and motor deficits, and shifted microglial activation marker profiles. The beneficial effects of T0901317 were abolished by LXR antagonist GSK 2033, accompanied by upregulation of necroptotic signaling. The neuroprotective effects of activating LXR may involve the regulation of the RIPK1-RIPK3-MLKL axis and TDP-43 aggregation.
items.titleZh: LXR通路激活剂T0901317：通过抑制坏死性凋亡相关RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL标志物，作为ALS相关认知与运动障碍的新型潜在实验策略
items.summaryZh: 这项研究探索了激活LXR通路（通过药物T0901317）对ALS模型（细胞和小鼠）中认知和运动功能的影响。结果显示，T0901317能减少TDP-43蛋白的异常聚集，抑制坏死性凋亡相关蛋白（RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL），改善小鼠的认知和运动缺陷，并延长生存期。这些效应在加入LXR拮抗剂后被逆转，提示LXR通路是关键靶点。该研究为ALS（尤其是伴有认知障碍的病例）提供了新的潜在治疗策略，但尚处于实验阶段。
items.insight: 这项研究首次将LXR通路激活与坏死性凋亡抑制联系起来，并针对ALS中常见的认知障碍表型，为开发同时改善运动与认知症状的疗法提供了新方向，值得ALS研究者关注。

items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在探讨合成LXR激动剂T0901317对转染TDP-43-A315T质粒的NSC-34小鼠神经元细胞及TDP-43-A315T转基因ALS小鼠模型中神经元坏死性凋亡相关信号通路的影响及机制。采用SWATH蛋白质组学分析比较伴有认知障碍（CI）和不伴认知障碍（NOCI）的ALS患者。通过免疫荧光和Western blotting评估TDP-43异常聚集及坏死性凋亡相关蛋白表达，通过TUNEL实验和ELISA检测凋亡和炎症细胞因子，通过H&E和甲苯胺蓝染色检查肌肉和运动神经元变性。此外，使用Y迷宫和Rotarod实验评估认知和运动功能。研究表明，伴有认知障碍的ALS患者中LXR通路下调更为显著。在TDP-43-A315T质粒转染的神经元细胞和TDP-43-A315T转基因小鼠模型中，RIPK1、p-RIPK3和p-MLKL蛋白水平上调。LXR激动剂T0901317在体内和体外均减少了TDP-43蛋白的异常聚集，并下调了RIPK1、p-RIPK3和p-MLKL的蛋白水平。此外，T0901317减轻了TDP-43-A315T小鼠的运动神经元死亡并改善了肌肉变性。T0901317显著延长了生存期，改善了认知和运动缺陷，并改变了小胶质细胞活化标志物谱。LXR拮抗剂GSK 2033可消除T0901317的有益作用，并伴随坏死性凋亡信号的上调。激活LXR的神经保护作用可能涉及调节RIPK1-RIPK3-MLKL轴和TDP-43聚集。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，聚焦于LXR激动剂在ALS模型中的转化潜力，通过靶向坏死性凋亡和TDP-43病理，为ALS治疗提供了新的实验依据。
